meta.name: test-assumptions
meta.description: Challenge a proposed solution by identifying and testing consequential assumptions. Use when the brief feels too certain or discovery reveals contradictions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把方案里没被验证的关键假设挑出来并逐条验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果方案看着太笃定,关键假设却还没验证过。
copy.tagline_en: Surface and test the key assumptions behind a proposed solution before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your plan feels over-confident and its key assumptions remain untested.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在动手前会先读任务上下文契约和方法文档,然后找出一个方案里那些会带来后果的关键假设,并逐一检验,而不是直接照做。
howto.when: 当方案说明显得过于确定,或调研过程中出现相互矛盾的信息时触发。

say.text: 这个方案看起来太顺了,帮我挑出里面关键的假设
say.note: 它会列出待检验的假设

say.text: 调研里出现了矛盾,帮我重新检验这个方案的假设
say.note: 基于已有材料重新检验

say.text: 这个方案哪些假设一旦不成立就会崩?怎么测?
say.note: 给出假设及其检验方式

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first reads the task context contract and the method, then identifies the consequential assumptions behind a proposed solution and tests them, instead of just executing it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the brief feels too certain, or when discovery reveals contradictions.

say_en.text: This plan looks too smooth—list the key assumptions behind it.
Discovery turned up contradictions—re-test this plan's assumptions.
Which assumptions would break this plan, and how do we test them?
say_en.note: Gives assumptions and how to test them.
